files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json ./
COPY src ./src
ENV PORT=8080
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["npm", "start"]
files.README.md:
# JavaScript stack

Minimal Node.js service using the built-in HTTP server and native test runner.

```bash
npm test
npm start
```

Health: `GET http://localhost:8080/health`.
